entry.title: Updated: dsh-tool-vision
entry.summary: Model-facing image_describe (识图) tool over the DashScope OpenAI-compatible API (qwen3.7-flash), plus a paste bridge: on text-only sessions, pasted images auto-convert to file paths at send time and render back in the transcript, so they never trip image admission. Bring your own DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; endpoint/model/budgets configurable, redirect-proof HTTP client, works in every agent preset. Exact install spec: github:wanshichenguang/dsh-tool-vision. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: description, description_i18n.
